title: SpecThread service health
description: Production only (deployment.environment.name = production). Source: observability/service-health.json; queries explained in observability/queries.md.

panels.title: API up (/health)
panels.description: Uptime check every 5 minutes from one probe. Red means at least one failed check in that slot.

panels.title: API uptime, 7 days
panels.description: Share of successful /health checks over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: API CPU
panels.description: CPU used by the API process, in cores. The line is Render free's 0.1 CPU (to recheck on Render).

panels.title: API memory
panels.description: Working set of the API process (largest instance during a deploy overlap). The line is 512 MB; sources disagree between 512 MB and 256 MB for Render free (to recheck).

panels.title: Web up (/login)
panels.description: Uptime check every 5 minutes from one probe. /login runs the Next.js server; the landing page is static and would not.

panels.title: Web requests per hour
panels.description: Server requests per route, from span metrics. Includes the uptime check's 12 requests an hour to GET /login.

panels.title: Web failed requests per hour
panels.description: Server spans marked as errors (5xx or a thrown error). Span metrics carry no HTTP status, so 4xx is only in the web failures table (last 24 h).

panels.title: Web slow requests per hour (over 2 s)
panels.description: Estimated from span-metric histograms, so counts are approximate.

panels.title: Database ready (/health/ready)
panels.description: Uptime check of the API's readiness endpoint, which runs SELECT 1 (ADR-061). Red with the API strip green means the database, or a full pool, is the problem.

panels.title: API connection pool
panels.description: Npgsql pool "specthread". Waiting above 0 means requests queued for a connection. Better Auth's own pool in the web app is not shown.

panels.title: Slowest queries, last 24 h (API)
panels.description: From API SQL spans grouped by query text. TraceQL is limited to 24 hours here, so this table ignores the dashboard's 7 days. p95 is bucketed (powers of two). Better Auth's queries run in the web app and have no query text, so they are not included. Total time is each query's share of database time (D20).

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "specthread-api" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span.db.query.text != nil } | count_over_time() by (span.db.query.text)
{ resource.service.name = "specthread-api" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span.db.query.text != nil } | avg_over_time(span:duration) by (span.db.query.text)
{ resource.service.name = "specthread-api" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span.db.query.text != nil } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, .95) by (span.db.query.text)
{ resource.service.name = "specthread-api" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span.db.query.text != nil } | sum_over_time(span:duration) by (span.db.query.text)

defaults.noValue: No API queries in the last 24 hours

panels.title: GitHub, Resend, Google sign-in
panels.description: GitHub and Resend: their status page reports a major or critical outage. Google: the sign-in discovery document is unreachable. Minor incidents stay green.

panels.title: GitHub calls per hour
panels.description: API calls to api.github.com (evidence links and refreshes). Empty until someone links or refreshes evidence.

panels.title: GitHub call latency (p95)
panels.description: From the API's HttpClient histogram for api.github.com.

panels.title: Most-failed requests, API, 7 days
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx are separate because some 4xx (401, 404, 409) are normal. Health checks are left out.

panels.title: Most-failed requests, web, last 24 h
panels.description: From web traces, which carry the HTTP status; span metrics don't, so this table is limited to TraceQL's 24 hours. Requests to /api/auth/[...all] are every Better Auth endpoint together, so sign-in 429s and sign-up 429s share a row.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "specthread-web" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span:kind = server } | count_over_time() by (span.http.method, span.http.route)

{ resource.service.name = "specthread-web" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span:kind = server && span.http.status_code >= 400 && span.http.status_code < 500 } | count_over_time() by (span.http.method, span.http.route)

{ resource.service.name = "specthread-web" && resource.deployment.environment.name = "production" && span:kind = server && span.http.status_code >= 500 } | count_over_time() by (span.http.method, span.http.route)

defaults.noValue: No web requests in the last 24 hours

panels.title: Slowest routes, 7 days
panels.description: Layers stack: web time includes the API time it waits for. API figures come from the request histogram, web figures from span metrics, so their percentiles are estimated differently. Linking and refreshing evidence call GitHub and are expected to take tens of seconds. Check Count before trusting a slow p95.
